areas.name: Skills and Permanent Upgrades
areas.location_cue: Camp skill menus, repair consoles, the drone interface, shops, and the Equipment screen.

levels.1: Spend earned points across every skill tab.
levels.2: Use camps to inspect Attack, Survival, Beta, Burst, and Tachy branches for empty nodes.
levels.3: Farm remaining skill points before the regional lock, buy every visible node in every base tree, and verify no purchasable node remains.

levels.1: A completed save opens additional combat upgrades.
levels.2: Start New Game Plus and inspect the expanded Beta and Burst branches at a camp.
levels.3: Carry the completed save into New Game Plus, earn enough points for every newly added Beta and Burst upgrade, and verify the Infinite Blade completion record in the system menu.

levels.1: Keep inspecting fallen Airborne bodies in every region.
levels.2: Collect Body Cores until the health meter reaches its first-run cap, then continue the added tiers in New Game Plus.
levels.3: Use every regional Body Core entry, then repeat core pickups in New Game Plus until the extended health cap stops increasing.

levels.1: Keep inspecting fallen Airborne bodies in every region.
levels.2: Collect Beta Cores until the energy meter reaches its first-run cap, then continue the added tiers in New Game Plus.
levels.3: Use every regional Beta Core entry, then repeat core pickups in New Game Plus until the extended Beta-energy cap stops increasing.

levels.1: Every major combat reward contributes to the weapon's final ceiling.
levels.2: Collect all normal and damaged Weapon Cores across successive cycles.
levels.3: Claim every regional core and exchange damaged sets when available; continue through New Game Plus until the weapon status displays level 40.

levels.1: Small carrier enemies hide the healing-capacity modules.
levels.2: Collect every Tumbler Expansion Module in the first run and the additional later-cycle modules.
levels.3: Defeat each module carrier in the regional checklist, then repeat the applicable pickups in New Game Plus until the tumbler shows Enhancement II level 8.

levels.1: Destroy every small module carrier and revisit the upgrade console.
levels.2: Collect all Drone Upgrade Modules and purchase every ranged-mode node.
levels.3: Use the regional module entries, then spend them at the drone upgrade interface until every ammunition and firing-mode node is filled, including later-cycle additions.

levels.1: The plain supply boxes also hide the bolts needed for equipment capacity.
levels.2: Open every box and spend each complete Omnibolt set at a repair console.
levels.3: Do not stop at the minimum expansion: clear all 299 base boxes, collect every Omnibolt they contain, and purchase every available Exospine socket expansion.

levels.1: Buy ordinary stock before expecting each vendor's hidden inventory.
levels.2: Raise Roxanne, Lyle, Kaya, D1G-g2r, Clyde, and other affinity meters to their maximum tier.
levels.3: Purchase inexpensive repeatable stock until each affinity tier advances, revisit after regional returns, then buy every newly revealed record, design, accessory, companion outfit, drone appearance, bait, and music item.

levels.1: Check every Exterior submenu and camp music list after updates and DLC tasks.
levels.2: Complete the glasses, earrings, hairstyles, companion outfits, drone appearances, accessories, and camp-track catalogues.
levels.3: Max every shop, enable both seasonal themes, clear all photo and collaboration tasks, claim the seven arranged tracks at the hub bar in New Game Plus, and verify no locked slot remains in any Exterior or music submenu.

levels.1: A later patch adds one more challenge after the first completed run.
levels.2: Choose Mann from Boss Challenge after campaign completion.
levels.3: Defeat Mann on Normal or Hardcore difficulty and claim the Royal Guard Suit reward.

levels.1: The collaboration quest chain adds its own final combat test.
levels.2: Finish all five NIKKE shooting missions, then open the added challenge.
levels.3: Defeat Scarlet on Normal and Hard, then claim the outfit, hairstyle, and music reward before leaving the DLC route.

areas.name: Endings, Later Cycles, and Secrets
areas.location_cue: The final camp, cleared-save continuation, seasonal hub and oasis variants, and the sealed Matrix 11 room.
areas.note: The outfit catalogue requires New Game, New Game Plus, and New Game Plus Plus reward passes even when ending backups reduce repeated finale runs.

levels.1: One final response leads to a distinct conclusion.
levels.2: At the final decision, choose the first response after entering with a fully completed companion-progress gauge.
levels.3: Back up at the final camp. With the optional-progress gauge full, choose the affirmative response, finish the remaining encounters, watch the complete ending and its added epilogue, then restore the backup.

levels.1: The same final response changes when optional progress is deliberately limited.
levels.2: Reach the final decision on a later cycle without filling the companion-progress gauge, then choose the first response.
levels.3: Use a New Game Plus speed run that avoids optional records and quests which raise the companion gauge. At the final camp make a backup, choose the affirmative response, and finish the resulting ending.

levels.1: The alternative final response leads to the remaining conclusion.
levels.2: At the final decision, choose the second response; gauge state does not gate this path.
levels.3: Restore the final-camp backup from either route, choose the negative response, complete the remaining encounter, and watch the ending through its post-credits return.

levels.1: A current patch adds short follow-up scenes after a qualifying conclusion.
levels.2: Complete the fully prepared affirmative ending on the current patch, then revisit the hub interactions made available afterward.
levels.3: After viewing the qualifying ending on patch 1.4.1 or later, continue the cleared save and inspect the newly available hub follow-ups until all three epilogue vignettes have played.

levels.1: The highest campaign setting is a separate mastery route.
levels.2: Select Hard for a carried-over cycle after finishing the first campaign.
levels.3: Start New Game Plus on Hard, retain your equipment, complete the full campaign without lowering the setting, and keep the cleared Hard save for Boss Challenge cleanup.

levels.1: A settings toggle keeps the summer content available outside its original season.
levels.2: Enable the summer theme, visit the Great Desert oasis, use the added interaction, and clear Clyde's seasonal stock.
levels.3: Set Seasonal Content to On, travel to the oasis, interact with the sunbed, buy both summer suits and the accessory from Clyde, and confirm the alternate camp tracks are selectable.

levels.1: A settings toggle keeps the holiday content available outside its original season.
levels.2: Enable the holiday theme and inspect the decorated city hub for its minigame and shop rewards.
levels.3: Set Seasonal Content to On, clear the holiday target minigame, then claim Santa Dress, the companion and drone outfits, the hairstyle, glasses, both earrings, and both seasonal music tracks.

levels.1: A late hidden request finally opens one previously sealed room.
levels.2: Complete Strange Signal, then revisit the Rotten Labyrinth route in Matrix 11.
levels.3: Fast travel to Temporary Armoury Entrance, ride the nearby lift, follow the right-hand route past the enemies, open the sealed door with θεθλβλ, inspect the full studio room, and take Ocean String.

save_backup.title: Back up at the final camp
save_backup.why: The last response branches permanently and one path also depends on optional-progress state.
save_backup.detail: Keep a full-progress final-camp copy for two outcomes; use a low-progress later cycle for the third.

point_of_no_return.title: Point of no return ahead
point_of_no_return.why: The response offered immediately after the final camp.
point_of_no_return.detail: Finish every open task and preserve the separate backup before confirming this transition.
